title: comment.deleted.v1
description: A comment was deleted by its author or by the video owner. Written to the comments service outbox in the same transaction as the deletion; delivered to each subscriber (likes, lake) as a separate row. Not emitted for the cascade caused by video.deleted.v1 (subscribers learn that from the video event). Topic name: comment.deleted.v1; partition key: videoId. Compatibility: only adding optional fields.

eventId.description: Event ID; the consumer deduplicates by it and by commentId.

traceId.description: W3C trace id; may be absent.

authorId.description: Keycloak sub of the comment author.

deletedBy.description: Keycloak sub of the actor: the author or the video owner.
